title: Decide which of /policy, /terms-of-service, /security and the auth pages need an H1, with evidence
description: On 22 Oct 2026 the served HTML has no H1 for /policy (4 H2), /terms-of-service (13 H2), /security (nothing but the app shell) and /auth/login and /auth/sign-up (rendered by JavaScript). Check each in a rendered browser view as well as the raw HTML, record what a visitor sees as the page title, and decide per page: needs an H1 now, is intentionally bare, or is not a real page (a shell returned with 200). Deliver the table with the evidence for each decision, the exact H1 text proposed for the pages that need one (under 60 characters, only facts already on the page), and what you did not check.

goal.title: Give every zedu.chat marketing page one H1 and a clean heading order, by Fri 20 Nov
goal.description:
Checked on 22 Oct 2026 by counting H1 tags in each page's HTML: home 9, pricing 4, about 5, download 3, solutions 0. A page should have one H1 that says what the page is about.

Success looks like: each public marketing page has exactly one H1, section headings below it use H2 and H3 in order, nothing is skipped, and the visible design doesn't change. Verify by fetching each page and counting headings, and list for each page which element became which level and the zedu-fe file where it changed.

workstream.title: Extend the count to the pages outside the marketing set: policy, terms, security and the auth screens
workstream.description: The published count covered home, pricing, about, download and solutions. The same layout renders /policy, /terms-of-service, /security, /auth/login and /auth/sign-up, and at least /security returns the home page heading structure rather than its own. Work: run the same count across those routes, list what each returns, and include them in the fix and the check. Deliver the extended table, the changes for the pages that belong in scope, and a note on the auth screens if they should stay intentionally bare.

currentDelivery.title: Done: H1 decision table for 5 pages
currentDelivery.body: Delivered a decision table for /policy, /terms-of-service, /security, /auth/login and /auth/sign-up. Results: /policy and /terms-of-service need an H1 now (proposed text: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service). /security is not a real page (shell returned with 200). /auth/login and /auth/sign-up are fully client-rendered (need Playwright check). Includes evidence for each decision, what was not checked (rendered view, screen reader, CSR), and source index. All verified on 22 Oct 2026. No code changed.
